Master Services Agreement between Acme Law Partners and Client X.

Effective Date: 2025-01-15.

Section 1. Scope of Services. Acme Law Partners agrees to provide legal
counsel to Client X regarding corporate matters, including contract review,
negotiation support, and regulatory compliance advice.

Section 2. Fees. Client X shall pay a flat monthly retainer of $12,000,
payable on the first business day of each month.

Section 3. Term. This agreement remains in effect for twelve (12) months
from the Effective Date and renews automatically unless either party
provides thirty (30) days written notice of non-renewal.
